lines: 头痛欲裂，像是被重型卡车反复碾过脑袋，陆衍猛地从冰冷白玉床榻上弹坐起来，粗重的喘息在偌大卧房里回荡。
陌生的雕花穹顶、古朴沉香木家具，还有身上绣着云纹的锦缎锦袍，全都在提醒他，眼前的一切绝不是自己加班猝死的出租屋。
无数杂乱破碎的记忆如同潮水，疯狂顺着脑海涌入，短短片刻，原主的一生尽数被陆衍全盘接收。
他穿越了。穿越到一个名叫玄洲的修仙大世界，成了青玄宗顶尖世家陆家的嫡长子，也就是原身陆衍。
原主妥妥的天命垫脚石配置，天道早早定下命格：专属天命反派，一生的使命就是充当宗门寒门天才苏辰的升级踏脚石。
靠着陆家顶级家世横行宗门，修为常年卡在炼气三层，空有家底毫无修炼天赋，平日里嚣张跋扈、蛮横霸道，仗着家世欺压普通弟子，全宗门上下没有一个人待见，名声烂到骨子里。
按照原本的命运轨迹，原主后续会一次次无脑去找苏的麻烦，每一次出手都刚好给苏辰送上机缘和名望，被天道气运层层反噬，最后陆家被苏辰连根拔起，满门覆灭，原主自己惨死在苏辰手下，尸骨无存。
“好家伙，穿个书直接地狱开局？”陆衍揉着发胀的太阳穴，现代社畜的灵魂一阵无语。上一秒还在通宵赶项目，猝死在电脑前，下一秒直接绑定必死反派剧本，这天道属实没给自己留活路。
原主之所以刚刚昏迷倒地，根源就在半天之前。陆家世代传承、镇守百年的祖传先天灵泉，被刚入宗门没多久的寒门弟子苏辰硬生生夺走。
那处灵泉扎根陆家封地地底，是陆家历代修士赖以修炼的根基，灵气醇厚，常年滋养陆家子弟，算得上陆家半条命脉。可苏辰靠着一身天道馈赠的金色气运，机缘巧合闯进灵泉地界，不仅霸占整座灵泉，还借着灵泉灵气当场突破修为，从炼气一层一跃踏入炼气五层。
更离谱的是，苏抢占私产非但没有半点过错，反倒被宗门一众长老当众表彰，大肆夸奖出身贫寒、自强不息，靠着自身机缘拿下宝地，是青玄宗未来的希望之星。
反观原主，守不住自家祖产，沦为全宗门上下嘲讽的废物纨绔，气急攻心之下怒火攻心，气血逆行直接晕死过去，才让来自蓝地球的陆衍鸠占鹊巢。
“天道明目张胆双标是吧？别人抢我的家产，抢完拿奖励，我丢了自家东西还要被全宗门笑话？”陆衍眉头紧皱，起身走到窗边，推开雕花木窗。
窗外不远处的青玄宗演武广场人声鼎沸，密密麻麻数百名宗门内门、外门弟子围聚在一起，喧闹的议论声顺着风飘进房间，字字句句都戳着陆衍的耳膜。
“你们听说没？苏辰师兄拿下陆家祖传灵泉，长老刚刚赏赐了三枚淬体丹！”
“不愧是天命眷顾的奇才，出身一无所有，短短半个月一路突飞猛进，反观陆衍，坐拥顶级家世，修炼三年卡在炼气三层，纯纯废物一个。”
“灵泉落在苏师兄手里才物尽其用，留在陆衍这种败家纨绔身上，纯属白白浪费天地灵气。”
“可怜陆家祖辈辛苦积攒的家底，要被陆衍一点点败光咯，连自家灵泉都看不住。”
漫天嘲讽没有半句公道，没有一人提起灵泉本是陆家私产，所有人都被无形的大势裹挟，下意识认定灵泉本就该属于气运加身的苏辰。
陆衍眯起眼睛，凝神朝着广场方向眺望。
视线穿透人群，正中央的青石高台之上，一名身着素布青衫的年轻男子静静伫立。
他面容俊朗，眉眼温润，嘴角始终挂着一抹谦和浅笑，正是整起事件的获利者、全书天命之子苏辰。
此刻一道道肉眼看不见的淡金色气运洪流从天而降，源源不断钻进苏辰体内，肉眼难以捕捉，唯有穿越过来的陆衍，靠着灵魂特殊才能清晰看见。
那些金光便是天道馈赠的本命气运，也是苏辰一路开挂、逢凶化、掠夺机缘的资本。
苏辰微微躬身，对着台上几位宗门长老连连拱手，语气谦逊得体：“诸位长老谬赞，晚辈不过运气稍好，侥幸寻得灵泉，算不上什么本事。若是陆师兄想要收回灵，晚辈也可拱手相让，只可惜陆师兄修行浅薄，怕是无法妥善利用灵泉灵气，白白糟蹋宝地。”
这话听着大度谦让，实则字字诛心。
表面看似愿意归还灵泉，实则暗踩陆衍资质低劣、不配拥有祖产，轻飘飘几句话，再次坐实陆纨绔废物的标签，台下弟子听闻，又是一阵哄笑嘲讽，源源不断的善意和气运再度朝着苏辰汇聚。
他嘴上退让，周身气运却半点没有流失，反而借着一番“大度发言再度暴涨，悄悄继续吸收灵泉溢出的精纯灵气，心安理得享用本该属于陆家的资源。
围观人群里有少数理智之人隐约觉得不对劲，灵泉是陆家世代产业，怎么变成苏辰的机缘？可但凡有人想要开口质疑，话音刚到嘴边便喉咙发紧、脑子发懵，莫名不敢出声，像是有一只无形大手按住了所有人的口舌。不用多想，这便是天道偏袒带来的隐性规则压制。
“好家伙，连舆论都能强行篡改，这天道为了捧天命之子，已经不讲半点道理了。”陆冷眼旁观苏辰的全套表演，心里把原主频频作死的原因摸得七七八八。
原主前世就是看不惯苏辰这套虚伪做派，每次被舆论抹黑之后，当场暴怒出手，当众辱骂动手，每次出手刚好落入苏辰圈套，被对方顺势卖惨，博取更多同情和气运，一步步把自己和陆家推向深渊。
若是换成之前的原主，听到外面漫天嘲讽，此刻早就拎着兵器冲去广场找苏辰玩命，正中对方下怀。但现在换了来自现代的陆衍，吃过社会毒打，心思沉稳，绝不会再走老路送死。
硬碰硬等于主动送机缘，这笔亏本买卖，他半点不做。
“少爷！”
厚重木门被匆匆推开，白发管家老周快步走进房间，满脸悲愤，皱纹都因为气恼拧成一团。老周是陆家老仆，跟着陆家老爷子半辈子，亲眼看着祖传灵泉被外人抢走，心里像被刀子割肉一般难受。
“少爷，苏辰霸占灵泉不讲道理，一众长老不分黑白偏袒那寒门小子，咱们直接集结陆家护卫，去灵泉驻地把灵泉抢回来！凭什么自家东西白白送人？”老周攥紧拳头，气得浑身发抖。在他眼里，自家少爷虽然往日顽劣，但陆家产业绝不能被外人巧取豪夺。
陆衍摆了摆手，抬手拦下管家冲动的想法，淡淡开口：“周伯，别急着冲动，现在出去硬碰硬，正中苏辰圈套。”
content_en:
With a splitting headache, as if his head had been repeatedly run over by a heavy truck, Lu Yan suddenly sat up from the cold white jade bed, his heavy breathing echoing in the large bedroom.
The unfamiliar carved dome, simple agarwood furniture, and brocade robes embroidered with cloud patterns all reminded him that what he saw in front of him was by no means the rental house where he died suddenly while working overtime.
Countless messy and broken memories were like a tide, pouring crazily into his mind. In just a few moments, the original owner's life was completely accepted by Lu Yan.
He traveled through time. He traveled to a world of immortal cultivation called Xuanzhou and became the eldest son of the Lu family, the top aristocratic family of the Qingxuan Sect, which was his original body, Lu Yan.
The original owner had a proper destiny stepping stone configuration, and Tiandao had already determined his destiny early on: he was the exclusive destiny villain, and his life's mission was to serve as a stepping stone for the upgrade of Su Chen, a genius from a poor sect.
Relying on the Lu family's top family background, he has been running rampant in the sect. His cultivation has been stuck at the third level of Qi refining all year round. He has no family resources and no cultivation talent. He is usually arrogant and overbearing. He bullies ordinary disciples based on his family background. No one in the whole sect wants to see him, and his reputation is rotten to the core.
According to the original destiny trajectory, the original owner would mindlessly seek trouble for Su again and again. Each time he made a move, he would just bring opportunities and fame to Su Chen, which would be counterattacked by the fate of heaven. In the end, the Lu family was uprooted by Su Chen, and the whole family was destroyed. The original owner himself died tragically at the hands of Su Chen, with no bones left.
"Good guy, are you going to start in hell by wearing a book?" Lu Yan rubbed his swollen temples, and the soul of a modern social animal was speechless. One moment, he was working on a project all night long and suddenly died in front of the computer. The next moment, he was directly bound to the script of a mortal villain. God really did not leave a way for him to survive.
The reason why the original owner fell unconscious just now was half a day ago. The ancestral innate spiritual spring passed down from generation to generation by the Lu family and guarded for hundreds of years was abruptly taken away by Su Chen, a disciple from a poor family who had just entered the sect.
That spiritual spring is rooted in the ground of the Lu family fiefdom and is the foundation for the cultivation of monks of the Lu family. The spiritual energy is mellow and nourishes the children of the Lu family all year round. It is half the lifeblood of the Lu family. But Su Chen, relying on the golden luck gifted by heaven, broke into the realm of Lingquan by chance. Not only did he occupy the entire Lingquan, he also used the spiritual energy of Lingquan to break through his cultivation level on the spot, leaping from the first level of Qi Refining to the fifth level of Qi Refining.
What's even more outrageous is that not only was Su not at fault for seizing private property, he was praised in public by the elders of the sect, praising him for being born in a poor family, constantly striving for self-improvement, relying on his own opportunities to win the treasure land, and that he was the future hope of the Qingxuan Sect.
On the other hand, the original owner was unable to defend his ancestral property and became a good-for-nothing that the entire sect ridiculed. He was furious and filled with rage. His energy and blood went retrograde and he fainted. Only then did Lu Yanjiu from Blue Earth occupy the magpie's nest.
"Tiandao is blatantly double-standard, isn't it? Others rob my property and get rewards for it, but I lose my belongings and still be laughed at by the whole sect?" Lu Yan frowned, stood up, walked to the window, and pushed open the carved wooden window.
The Qingxuan Sect's Martial Arts Plaza not far from the window was bustling with people. Hundreds of disciples from the inner and outer sects gathered together. The noisy discussion floated into the room along the wind, and every word pierced Lu Yan's eardrums.
"Have you heard? Senior Brother Su Chen took over the Lu family's ancestral spiritual spring, and the elder just rewarded him with three body tempering pills!"
"As expected of a genius blessed by fate, he came from nothing and made rapid progress in just half a month. On the other hand, Lu Yan, who comes from a top family background, has been stuck on the third level of Qi refining for three years, and is a pure waste."
"The spiritual spring can only be put to good use if it falls into the hands of Senior Brother Su. Leaving it in the possession of a prodigal dude like Lu Yan is a complete waste of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth."
"It's pitiful that the Lu family's ancestors have worked so hard to accumulate wealth. Lu Yan is going to destroy it bit by bit. He can't even see his own spiritual spring."
There was no justice in the ridicule. No one mentioned that Lingquan was originally the private property of the Lu family. Everyone was coerced by the invisible trend and subconsciously concluded that Lingquan should belong to Su Chen who was blessed with luck.
Lu Yan narrowed his eyes and looked towards the square attentively.
Looking through the crowd, on the high bluestone platform in the center, a young man wearing a plain blue shirt stood quietly.
He has a handsome face, gentle eyebrows and a gentle smile on his lips. He is the beneficiary of the whole incident and the destined son of the whole book, Su Chen.
At this moment, streams of pale golden luck invisible to the naked eye fell from the sky and penetrated into Su Chen's body continuously. It was difficult to catch with the naked eye. Only Lu Yan, who had traveled through time, could clearly see it with his special soul.
Those golden lights are the destiny gifted by heaven, and they are also Su Chen's capital for cheating, turning danger into danger, and plundering opportunities.
Su Chen bowed slightly, raised his hands to several sect elders on the stage, and said in a humble and decent tone: "Elders, I'm just a bit more lucky, and finding the spirit spring by chance is not a big deal. If Senior Brother Lu wants to take back the spirit, I can give it to him, but it's a pity that Senior Brother Lu's practice is shallow, and I'm afraid he won't be able to properly utilize the spiritual energy of the spiritual spring, and waste the treasure land in vain."
These words may sound magnanimous and modest, but in reality they are heart-breaking.
On the surface, he seemed willing to return the spiritual spring, but in fact, he secretly criticized Lu Yan for his low qualifications and unworthy of possessing the ancestral property. With a few words, he once again firmly labeled Lu Yan as a playboy and a waste. When the disciples in the audience heard this, they burst into laughter and ridicule again, and a steady stream of goodwill and luck gathered towards Su Chen again.
He gave in, but the luck in his body was not lost at all. Instead, he surged again with his "magnanimous speech", quietly continued to absorb the pure spiritual energy overflowing from the spiritual spring, and enjoyed the resources that should belong to the Lu family with peace of mind.
There were a few rational people in the crowd who vaguely felt that something was wrong. Lingquan had been the Lu family's property for generations, how could it become Su Chen's opportunity? But whenever someone wanted to question something, their throats would tighten and their brains would become confused as soon as the words came to their lips. They dared not speak out for some reason, as if there was an invisible hand holding everyone's tongue. No need to think too much, this is the suppression of hidden rules brought about by the favor of heaven.
"Good guy, even public opinion can be forcibly tampered with. In order to support the destiny's son, this Heavenly Dao no longer makes any sense." Lu Leng watched Su Chen's full performance, and he was confused about the reasons why the original owner frequently tried to commit suicide.
The original owner couldn't stand Su Chen's hypocrisy in his previous life. Every time he was smeared by public opinion, he would get angry on the spot and insult him in public. Every time he made a move, he just fell into Su Chen's trap and was betrayed miserably by the other party. He gained more sympathy and luck, and pushed himself and the Lu family step by step into the abyss.
If it had been the previous owner, hearing the ridicule outside, he would have rushed to the square with weapons to fight for Su Chen's life, playing into the opponent's hands. But now it is Lu Yan who comes from modern times. He has been beaten by society and has a calm mind. He will never follow the same old path and die.
To confront someone head-on is to give him an opportunity. He would not do anything about this loss-making transaction.
"Master!"
The heavy wooden door was pushed open in a hurry, and the white-haired housekeeper Lao Zhou walked into the room quickly, his face full of sorrow and anger, and his wrinkles were knitted together with anger. Lao Zhou is an old servant of the Lu family. He has been with the old man of the Lu family for half his life. He watched the ancestral spiritual spring being taken away by outsiders, and his heart felt like being cut with a knife.
"Master, Su Chen's occupation of Lingquan is unreasonable. All the elders favor that poor boy regardless of right or wrong. Let's directly gather the Lu family guards and go to Lingquan Station to snatch Lingquan back! Why should we give away our own things for nothing?" Old Zhou clenched his fists and was shaking with anger. In his eyes, although his young master was naughty in the past, the Lu family's property must not be taken advantage of by outsiders.
Lu Yan waved his hand, raised his hand to stop the housekeeper's impulsive thoughts, and said calmly: "Uncle Zhou, don't be so impulsive. If you go out and fight hard now, you will fall into Su Chen's trap."
